claim.claim-text: 1. A subsystem (1) for moving a battery block (23), the subsystem comprising:
2. The subsystem according to Claim 1, wherein the lift mechanism comprises at least one scissor type lift comprising at least one pair of vertical scissor columns (14) .

3. The subsystem according to Claim 1 or 2, the subsystem further comprising a control unit (20) adapted to control the trolley movement in the first direction and/or the second direction and the lift mechanism movement in the third direction.
4. The subsystem according to any one of Claims 1-3, wherein the top surface of the platform comprising a plurality of rollers (21) adapted to reliably support the battery block.
5. The subsystem according to any one of Claims 1-4, the subsystem further comprising a trolley moving mechanism (11) coupled to the trolley and adapted to move the trolley in the first direction.

6. The subsystem according to Claim 5, the subsystem further comprising at least one rail (10) extending in the first direction and the trolley moving mechanism is adapted to move the trolley on the at least one rail in the first direction.
7. The subsystem according to Claim 6, wherein the trolley further comprises a plurality of wheels (12) adapted to reliably support the trolley on the at least one rail.

8. The subsystem according to Claim 6 or 7, the subsystem further comprising two spaced apart parallel rails and the trolley further comprise two sets of wheels arranged on opposite sides of the trolley, wherein the sets of wheels are configured to reliably support the trolley on the two rails.
9. A battery storage and charge system (22) comprising at least one subsystem (1) according to any one of Claims 5-8, the system further comprising:

10. The system according to Claim 9, wherein each shelf (25) of the plurality of shelves (25) further comprise at least one battery block guide (26) configured to guide the battery block when being transferred to the shelf.

11. The system according to Claim 10 or 11, wherein each shelf (25) of the plurality of shelves (25) further comprises a plurality of rollers (21) thereon, the plurality of rollers adapted to reliably support the battery block.

12. The system according to any one of Claims 9-11, wherein the at least one subsystem further comprises at least one rail (10) extending in the first direction and the at least one rail forms a pathway (35) extending in the first direction, the system having at least two of the racks separated by the pathway.
13. A battery exchange station comprising the system according to any one of Claims 9-12, the battery exchange station further comprising:

14. The station according to Claim 13, wherein the at least one subsystem is adapted to move the battery block (23) to the position in the first (Y) and the second (X) direction horizontally corresponding the opening in the vehicle lane and extend in the third substantially vertical direction (Z), the at least one subsystem being configured to place the battery block (23) into a battery dock within the electrical vehicle or remove the battery block (23) from the electrical vehicle.

15. The station of Claim 14, wherein the vehicle lane comprises a first side (33) and a second side (34) spaced from the first side in the first direction (Y), wherein the battery exchange station includes several racks close to respectively the first side and/or the second side of the vehicle lane, and the at least one rail extends between the racks.
